_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid#0 — the fluid section names, plus the one wrong name section-name validation does NOT catch. On a self-contained 2-D deck (unit square of FLUID QUAD4 + MAT_fluid, u=1 driven in on the left edge, no-slip top and bottom, pressure pinned at a corner) the correct pair 'FLUID DYNAMIC' + 'FLUID ELEMENTS' exits 0 with its result test CORRECT. 'FLUID', 'FLUID_DYN' and the bare 'STRUCTURE' are each rejected verbatim from core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp with "Section '<name>' is not a valid section name." — so the bare word the entry warns about is not even a section. The fourth arm is the trap: 'STRUCTURE ELEMENTS' IS a real section name and is NOT rejected (STRUCTELE_SECTION_NAME_REJECTED=0); the elements simply never reach the fluid field, and the abort blames something else entirely — 'Pressure map empty. Wrong DIM value in input file?' from src/fluid/4C_fluid_implicit_integration.cpp, with no mention of FLUID ELEMENTS anywhere in the log (STRUCTELE_BLAMED_THE_ELEMENT_SECTION=0), while PROBLEM SIZE/DIM is in fact correct. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'FLUID' is not a valid section name.
Section 'FLUID_DYN' is not a valid section name.
Section 'STRUCTURE' is not a valid section name.
Pressure map empty. Wrong DIM value in input file?

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the first wrong section name: use the real one. EXIT_FLUIDSEC goes to 0 and its rejection line disappears, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the underscored variant the same way; its rejection line disappears and the fixture must go red.

remove the pathology from the misdirected element section: put the elements back under FLUID ELEMENTS. EXIT_STRUCTELE goes to 0 and the misleading DIM diagnostic disappears, so the fixture must go red — that arm is the one that carries the trap.
